description_en: Adds configurations of connecting the audit logs of a third-party cloud asset
description_zh: 增加第三方云资产审计日志接入配置
name: AddCloudVendorTrialConfig

parameters.help_en:
The AccessKey ID.

[](#-describecloudvendoraccountaklist--authid)You can call the [DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~) operation to query the AccessKey ID
parameters.name: auth_id

parameters.help_en:
The service provider of the cloud asset. Valid values:

Tencent: Tencent Cloud.
AWS: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

Tencent：腾讯云
AWS：微软
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en:
The configurations of the third-party cloud asset. Valid values:

AWS: Configure the sqsQueueName and sqsRegion parameters.
Tencent: Configure the kafkaUserName, kafkaBootstrapServers, and kafkaTopic parameters
parameters.help_zh:
输入多云配置信息：
AWS: 入参 sqsQueueName、sqsRegion
Tencent: 入参  kafkaUserName、kafkaBootstrapServers、kafkaTopic
parameters.name: auth_info

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
